integrity: The result is a complete elementary proof using t disjoint difference sets and optimal-host coset rigidity. Finite verifier is a stress test, not proof of universal statements. The known bipartite and K_{1,1,n} cases are credited. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only induced abelian Cayley hosts for complete multipartite graphs with at least two nonempty parts; group structures and all embeddings beyond forced coset positions are not classified; independently verified publication priority not established.
title: Exact minimal abelian Cayley hosts of all complete multipartite graphs
